app.header:
# YuE2 Song Studio
Turn lyrics into a full song, with a score you can edit.
app.footer: Powered by [YuE2](https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE). Individual creators can use and monetize what they make; companies need a license for commercial use. Please credit #YuE2.

create.review_first_info: Pauses after the score so you can listen and edit before recording.

editor.intro: Edit the melody, chords, tempo, or key and record it as a new version. Your original is kept.
editor.valid: Looks good · {bpm} BPM · key {key} · {meter} · {measures} bars · about {seconds}s
editor.style_info: You can change the sound too.
editor.lyrics_info: One syllable per sung note works best.
editor.help:
- `Q:1/4=88`: tempo in BPM · `K:C`: key · `M:4/4`: meter
- `"Am7"`: chord above the next note (Vocal part only)
- `V: Vocal` is the sung melody, `V: Ins` is the instrument melody
- Notes: `c d e` (octave up `c'`, down `C`), sharp `^c`, flat `_e`. The number after a note is its length in 32nds (`c8` = quarter note)
- `z8` is a rest, `Z` is a full bar of rest, `-` ties a note to the next
- Every line must end on a full bar. Use **Check score** before recording.
instrumental.intro: Make music without vocals from a description or from a song in your library.
instrumental.keep_chords_info: Off lets the new arrangement pick its own chords.
instrumental.plan_mode_info: Used when starting from a description.

cover.start_info: Where the part you want begins
cover.keep_harmony_info: Off lets the new arrangement pick its own chords.
cover.hear_lyrics_info: Writes down the sung words (about 20 seconds more). Check them before you use them.
cover.title_placeholder: Leave blank to use the file name
cover.lyrics_info: Write new lyrics under each section tag, following the melody's phrasing.

abc.duration: a note length of {units} isn't allowed. Split it into shorter notes joined with "-".
abc.overflow: the notes run past the end of the bar.
abc.bar_length: the bar isn't full. Add or remove notes or rests.
abc.empty_bar: there's an empty bar or an unsupported bar line.
abc.bars_per_line: each line can hold 1 to 4 bars.
abc.voice_order: each line needs "V: Vocal" followed by "V: Ins".
abc.bar_count: the vocal and instrument lines have a different number of bars.
abc.tie: a tie ("-") must join two notes of the same pitch.
abc.tie_end: the last note is tied to nothing. Remove the final "-".
abc.pitch: a note is too high or too low.
abc.octave: a note mixes "," and "'" octave marks.
abc.rest_marks: a rest can't have sharps, flats, octave marks or ties.
abc.key: the key "{key}" isn't supported. Use a major or minor key like K:C or K:Am.
abc.meter: the meter must be a fraction like M:4/4.
abc.tempo: the tempo line must look like Q:1/4=90.
abc.header: the header lines at the top (X:, T:, M:, L:, Q:, V:, K:) were changed. Keep them as they were.
abc.unknown: part of the score isn't in a supported format.
